_about: The Curious Lore of Precious Stones (1913): the paragraphs kept (chapter.section.paragraph, "to" for a short run), each with the title it's shown under, its stones and other names to find it by, and the picture that shows it, if one does. Chapters I to X only (XI is remedies). Read by hand, then checked again: the curious kept; contempt for peoples or faiths, sex, gore, cruelty to animals, health claims and charms someone might try, misogyny, ableism, harm to children, and anything taking gender or sexuality lightly, left out. See ktdi/tools/gem_build.py.
